decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the product feed, I noticed many items are backpacking accessories (stoves, chairs, food) rather than actual backpacks. Among the actual bags, I selected five representing different use cases: a sling bag for travel/hiking, two sports-specific bags for baseball/softball, a basic mesh gym bag, and a wheeled travel backpack. I decided to purchase the NICGID Sling Bag (prod_backpacks_159) because it has a high rating (4.5), a large number of reviews (3952), and offers versatile daily utility for a reasonable price ($26.99). The sports-specific bags were high quality but too specialized for a general-purpose choice.
